name: sql-schema-copilot
description: Local SQL schema and migration assistant for VS Code.

chatParticipants.name: sqlschema
chatParticipants.description: Ask questions about your local SQL schema and migrations.

sqlSchemaCopilot.provider.description: Choose the LLM provider for schema explanations: a local Ollama instance, or a cloud model using your own API key.

sqlSchemaCopilot.cloudProviderKind.description: Which cloud provider to use when "provider" is set to "cloud".

sqlSchemaCopilot.embeddingProvider.description: Embedding method for local retrieval. "hashing" needs no extra install. "transformers-js" gives richer semantic search but requires running: npm install @xenova/transformers.

sqlSchemaCopilot.schemaFolderPath.description: Relative path to the folder containing schema files (for example: schema or schema/migration).

sqlSchemaCopilot.cloudApiKey.description: Stored securely in SecretStorage. Do not edit this value in settings.json.

scripts.test:unit: mocha out/test/suite/parser.test.js out/test/suite/chunking.test.js out/test/suite/hashingEmbeddingProvider.test.js out/test/suite/vectorStore.test.js out/test/suite/migrationDiff.test.js out/test/suite/typegen.test.js out/test/suite/relationshipGraph.test.js out/test/suite/schemaEngine.test.js
